title: Flow-Cytometry Immunophenotyping Workflow

source_steps.summary: Assign the experimental sample and seven control tubes.
Aliquot PBMCs into each assigned tube.
Wash and retain the cell pellets.
Resuspend, block, mix, and incubate the cells.
Prepare the isotype, single-antibody, and unstained-control reagents.
Apply the assigned reagents and incubate protected from light.
Wash the samples twice and retain the pellets.
Fix, mix, and incubate the cells.
Wash, resuspend, and hold the fixed cells.
Acquire and return eight identified event streams.

semantic_boundaries.label: Flow-cytometry analysis
semantic_boundaries.paper_wording: Compensation, gating, population calling, and percentages remain downstream analyses over the recorded event streams.

paper_safe_claims: The program explicitly models the experimental sample together with its acquisition controls.
Declared benchmark retention fractions preserve cell-bound staining components through subsequent washes.
The wet-lab acquisition structure is separated from downstream event analysis.
avoid_claiming: Do not claim compensation, gating, or population results that are not computed by the program.
